verdict.rationale: Kling's own site advertises "MCP / CLI — Let Your Agent Power Kling," which indicates a first-party CLI aimed at agent-driven workflows. That is the only mention, a single marketing line with no detail on how the CLI works. The REST API with JWT auth is a building block and earns no credit as a CLI. Missing for 10: CLI documentation (install, commands, auth), evidence of the CLI's actual scope and feature coverage, and hands-on or independent corroboration that it works.
